Overview

Santa Rosa de Copán is a city in CP with a population of 70,000. A highland city near the famous Maya ruins of Copán, known for its tobacco and coffee production. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
